$comment: Seeded from the frozen v1 discovery schema at the RFC 0266 §C cut-over (byte-equal to the 2.49.12 derivation); v2-owned since, edited by hand.

inflightCap.description: Optional host-side concurrent-inflight cap the conformance suite can saturate. When advertised, the production-backpressure scenario issues `inflightCap + 1` concurrent long-lived requests to deterministically force a 503. When absent, the scenario soft-skips the saturation step (envelope assertion still runs if a 503 happens to fire).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Optional advertised Retry-After value in seconds the host returns on 503. When present, MUST equal the `Retry-After` header the host sends with `503 service_unavailable`. Upper bound 86400 (24h) — values beyond that are operationally indistinguishable from 'permanently denied'. Hosts needing longer holds SHOULD omit `Retry-After` entirely (RFC 0009 Q#2).

minWindowSeconds.description: Documented minimum retention window in seconds. Per conformance.md §Production profile, MUST be ≥ 604800 (7 days) for public hosts; development-only hosts MAY advertise a smaller window but MUST NOT advertise this facet while doing so.

testForceExpire.description: Host exposes a test-only force-expire hook the conformance suite can call (URL/method supplied via `OPENWOP_TEST_FORCE_EXPIRE_URL` / `OPENWOP_TEST_FORCE_EXPIRE_METHOD` env vars). When `false`, the production-retention-expiry scenario asserts only the 410/404 envelope shape on an operator-supplied already-expired run id (via `OPENWOP_TEST_EXPIRED_RUN_ID`); otherwise it soft-skips. RFC 0009 unresolved question #1 — endpoint normation is deferred.

debugBundle.description: Debug-bundle truncation advertisement (conformance.md §Production profile): the production-profile MUSTs for a debug bundle (`debug-bundle.schema.json`) — truncation metadata, redaction. v2 defines no debug-bundle operation; how a host serves a bundle is host-defined.

truncationMetadata.description: When `true`, host surfaces `truncated: true` + non-empty `truncatedReason` (`debug-bundle.schema.json`) when caps are reached.
